title: casuarina distyla var. rigida
intro: Casuarina distyla var. rigida, commonly known as New Zealand silver pine or mountain she-oak, is a plant species in the Casuarinaceae family, native to New Zealand. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help in relieving respiratory issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Casuarina distyla var. rigida include analgesic, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it a potential remedy for pain management and skin infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
